name: board climbing
description: Bouldering on a steep standardised training board with a fixed layout of holds and set problems. It builds finger strength, body tension and power on hard moves.
instructions: Warm up thoroughly on easier terrain before you get on the board.
Start with a few easy board problems to get used to the angle.
Choose problems that fit the session goal, from hard single moves to linked circuits.
Press your feet into the footholds to keep body tension.
End the session when your finger or pulling strength clearly drops.
